items.definition:
a complicated irregular network of passages or paths in which it is difficult to find one's way; a maze
The ancient palace was a labyrinth of corridors.

the state of being in existence but not yet developed or manifest; delay
High latency can cause problems in online gaming.

objects kept or collected because of their historical interest, especially those associated with famous people or events
The museum displayed sports memorabilia from the 1950s.

a lyric poem in the form of an address to a particular subject, often elevated in style or manner and written in varied or irregular meter
The poet wrote an ode to joy.

the offense of willfully telling an untruth in a court of law
He was charged with perjury for lying under oath.

Rhesus factor
Her blood type is O negative, meaning she has Rh-negative blood.

a mythical enormous bird of prey
In Arabian mythology, the roc was a giant bird capable of carrying off elephants.

a decisive defeat or confrontation
The debate turned into a political smackdown.

the quality of dealing with ideas rather than events
The concept of time is an abstraction.

a thing added to something else as a supplementary rather than an essential part
The new department was an adjunct to the existing faculty.

the act or offense of speaking sacrilegiously about God or sacred things
His comments were considered an act of blasphemy by many.

a rank in the British army, above colonel and below major general
The brigadier gave orders to his troops.

the killing of a large number of people
The battle resulted in terrible carnage.

a hard, dark, granular mineral used for grinding and polishing
He used an emery board to file his nails.

the branch of medicine that deals with the incidence, distribution, and possible control of diseases
Epidemiology plays a crucial role in public health.

the chemical breakdown of a substance by bacteria, yeasts, or other microorganisms
Yeast is essential for the fermentation of grapes into wine.

bold, impudent behavior; bitterness of spirit
He had the gall to accuse me of lying.

a large fire that is dangerously out of control
The old factory was engulfed in an inferno.

A person who is sexually attracted to children.
The police arrested the pedophile.

The outer limits or edge of an area or object.
The city's poorer districts are on its periphery.

An action or event serving as an introduction to something more important.
The small skirmish was a prelude to a full-scale war.

the process of making something stable or steady
Economic stabilization is crucial for growth.

a form of written command in the name of a court or other legal authority
The court issued a writ of habeas corpus.

a mound of rough stones built as a memorial or landmark
They built a cairn to mark the summit of the mountain.

a reckless person
He was known as a daredevil for his stunts.

a difference or inconsistency
There was a discrepancy between the two reports.

a collection of documents about a person or subject
The detective compiled a dossier on the suspect.

the act of obtaining something by force or threats
He was charged with extortion.

a country house with farm buildings
They lived in an old grange on the outskirts of the village.

introduction of a new element
The new manager brought a fresh infusion of ideas to the team.

fat or oil
Lipids are essential for cell membrane structure.

title of a lord
His Lordship arrived in a grand carriage.

supernatural power
In some cultures, certain objects are believed to possess mana.

variation in strength, tone, or pitch
The singer's voice showed excellent modulation throughout the song.

a nuclear weapon
The treaty aimed to reduce the number of nukes.

supernatural beliefs, practices, or phenomena
She had a strong interest in the occult.

the branch of medicine dealing with children and their diseases
She decided to specialize in pediatrics.

a book containing a team's strategies and plays; a set of rules or strategies to be followed
The coach reviewed the playbook with the team.

the circulating life force whose existence and properties are the basis of much Chinese philosophy and medicine
In traditional Chinese medicine, good health depends on the balance of qi.

a complex or unwelcome consequence of an action or event
The new policy had many unforeseen ramifications.

a source of help in a difficult situation
He had no recourse but to accept the offer.

a survey or review of a past course of events or period of time
In retrospect, it was a bad decision.

a violent windy storm
The ship was caught in a fierce tempest.

a framework supporting a roof, bridge, or other structure
The bridge was supported by a strong steel truss.

a large German airship of the early 20th century
The Hindenburg was a famous zeppelin.

maximum extent of a vibration
The amplitude of the sound wave determined its loudness.

analysis of a substance
The laboratory performed an assay to determine the purity of the gold.

fundamental principles
Honesty is the bedrock of any strong relationship.

the act of sticking together
The team showed great cohesion during the difficult project.

a channel for fluid or wires
The pipe served as a conduit for the electrical cables.

the fact or process of being set free from legal, social, or political restrictions; liberation
The Emancipation Proclamation declared slaves free.

a person or thing that is a perfect example of a particular quality or type
She was the epitome of elegance.

the action of handing over a person accused or convicted of a crime to the jurisdiction of the foreign state in which the crime was committed
The country requested his extradition for fraud charges.

a situation of intense activity, typically a battle or argument
He jumped into the fray to defend his friend.

an experience involving the apparent perception of something not present
He suffered from vivid hallucinations during his illness.

a varied mixture of people or things; a piece of music combining several tunes
The band played a medley of their greatest hits.

a professional soldier hired to serve in a foreign army
The king hired mercenaries to protect his borders.

a person who advocates or practices minimalism
She adopted a minimalist lifestyle, owning very few possessions.

soft or semi-liquid food, especially for babies or invalids; worthless or trivial reading matter or entertainment
The doctor recommended a diet of pap for the patient.

a difficult, unpleasant, or embarrassing situation
He found himself in a difficult predicament after losing his wallet.

each of four parts of a circle, sphere, or other shape divided by two lines or planes at right angles
The city was divided into four quadrants for administrative purposes.

the action or process of calculating or estimating something; a time when past mistakes or misdeeds must be paid for
The day of reckoning will come for those who broke the law.

comfort or consolation in a time of distress
She found solace in music after the breakup.

a country gentleman; a young nobleman attending a knight
The squire accompanied the knight on his quest.
